inlines.v: ODORIF'EROUS, adjective [Latin odoriferus; odor and fero, to bear.] 1. Giving scent; diffusing fragrance; fragrant; perfumed; usually, sweet of scent; as odoriferous spices; odoriferous flowers. 2. Bearing scent; as odoriferous gales.
